welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.intro: This is your first note. A quick tour of what's new, section by section.
welcome.style_bullet_bold: **Bold**: add ** around the word to make it stand out more.
welcome.style_bullet_italic: *Italic*: add * around the word for a softer emphasis.
welcome.style_bullet_strike: ~~Strikethrough~~: add ~~ around the word to mark it as discarded.
welcome.style_bullet_code: `Code`: add ` around the word to show it in code format.
welcome.style_footer: **Would rather not type the symbols?** Use the icons in the bottom bar.
welcome.organize_bullet_quote: **Quote**: add > at the start of the line to highlight an important part.
welcome.organize_bullet_task: **To-do list**: add - [ ] at the start of the line to mark something pending.
welcome.organize_bullet_table: **Table**: add | between each column to sort data into rows and columns.
welcome.organize_quote_example: This is what a highlighted quote looks like.
welcome.organize_task_example: Check this off once you're done
welcome.tools_tags_body: Organize your notes by topic and find them fast.
welcome.tools_templates_body: Create new notes with a ready-to-use structure.
welcome.tools_history_body: Go back to an earlier version of your note.
welcome.tools_export_body: Save your note as a Markdown file.
welcome.tools_share_body: Send it straight to another app.
welcome.pro_versions_body: Unlimited, so you can go back to any point in your note.
welcome.pro_subfolders_body: As many as you need to organize your repositories.
welcome.pro_accents_body: Customize them to make the app feel like yours.
welcome.pro_cta: 💡 You can try it anytime from Settings.
